Category: V2G Maximum Capacity available at Peak
Description: Theoretical vehicle-to-grid (V2G) capacity available at time of winter transmission system peak, 5pm-6pm (all engaged cars & vans are parked residentially at this time, and all engaged HGV's and buses are parked at the depot at this time). Capacity actually dispatched depends on market conditions
